name: PPPP Active Runtime Manifest

statusDefinitions.BASE_DIRECT: Loaded directly by the application HTML before the additive runtime bootstrap. It may be foundational without owning the final visible UI.
statusDefinitions.FOUNDATION_REQUIRED: Current foundational shell or host layer required by later runtime owners. It may be visually superseded while still providing DOM, classes, globals or lifecycle hooks that later modules depend on.
statusDefinitions.FINAL_OWNER: Known current owner/finalizer for a visible runtime area. Later modules may still decorate it.
statusDefinitions.COMPATIBILITY: Required bridge, adapter, safety wrapper or migration layer. Do not infer UI ownership from this file.
statusDefinitions.LOADED_LEGACY_CANDIDATE: Still loaded in production but likely superseded in visible behavior. Must not be removed until callers, globals, events and smoke tests are traced.
statusDefinitions.LEGACY_FALLBACK_REQUIRED: Legacy layer intentionally retained because a current user-accessible fallback still depends on its behavior. Do not retire it until that fallback is removed or replaced.
statusDefinitions.ACTIVE_PROVIDER: Conditionally active runtime provider loaded outside the main bootstrap.
statusDefinitions.DYNAMIC_CURRENT: Current production module loaded dynamically by another current runtime file rather than by the main bootstrap.
statusDefinitions.LOADED_CURRENT_UNCLASSIFIED: Loaded by the production bootstrap and therefore treated as required until explicitly classified.

areas.note: Workspace Architecture provides the shell. Native UI v3 is the early presentation owner. Operating Experience remains the cross-area desktop presentation/navigation owner. Mobile Responsive v1 is a <=900px presentation/navigation-only shell that reuses canonical routes, adds no Supabase reads/writes or polling, and leaves business/data ownership unchanged. UI Runtime Stability observes route settling without cloning pages, duplicating ids, intercepting clicks or owning routing. Mobile PIN Unlock v1 is a device-local <=900px quick-unlock layer over an already valid remembered Supabase session. It stores no plaintext PIN or password, adds no Supabase/network reads, and falls back to full login when the session is unavailable or after repeated failures. RBAC startup now keeps role resolution bound to the authenticated identity in standalone PWA mode and never converts a transient startup delay into Viewer; exact-email fallback is allowed only after an authenticated user_id row miss.

Canonical Home remains the sole Home data/state owner. Existing Mobile Home and Mobile Control Tower stay loaded as compatibility/utility providers. Mobile App v2 is the final <=900px presentation shell: it owns the four-tab Home/Projects/Discover/Inbox mobile experience, real swipe presentation, compact fixed Weather/FX/Steel utilities and the central + sheet while delegating all business data/actions to existing PPPP owners. It adds no independent business-state engine.

Projects Operator Desk v2 is the single visible Projects owner. It performs one bounded project read, groups automatically by canonical operational_state, makes the full row the project-open target, and exposes no direct status/write menu. Project Classification and Lifecycle Tracking remain compatibility/context layers and yield their list presentation when v2 is active.

Project Integrity UI owns the bounded base project load. Canonical Project Workflow remains the navigation/business-route owner. Project Workbench v3 (compatibility file pristeel-project-workbench-v2.js) is the exclusive visible Project Detail presentation owner. It consumes bounded registered commercial context facts and the read-only pppp_project_workflow_state_v1 evidence model through Project Data Integrity. The three PPPP V2 entry lanes converge on the existing supplier/commercial engines and continue through Customer PO, Supplier PO, Procurement, Transport, Delivery, Invoice, Payment and Closed. Operator Flow, Unified Project Flow, Operating Experience, Daily Zones and the post-award presentation simplifier must yield whenever Workbench v3 is intended or active. Workbench also listens to the canonical pst:project-workspace-rendered lifecycle event so a project opened after bootstrap immediately receives the Workbench surface; the Execution Guard remains the lifecycle safety owner. No ownership layer performs automatic outbound communication or business-data writes.
Contact Master is the final relationship register.

Legacy dach-steel filename is retained for compatibility. The visible owner is Material Trade across EU + CH + ME + RS: Tier 1 direct steel consumers/fabricators/manufacturers, Tier 2 construction/GC-GU only with steel-procurement evidence. Buyer rows surface company intelligence, steel scope, public contact evidence and source links; a named project is optional and never invented. Lifecycle is ready-to-contact → Gmail draft → sent/waiting → replied/active → human-confirmed trading Project, while discovery/runtime remains explicitly separate from TED/Mundësitë.

Tender discovery engines remain backstage. Project-Centric Workflow remains the visible Opportunities owner. The dossier analyzer owns public/partial dossier reading; protected KRPP documents are imported through the purpose-limited pristeel-tender-dossier-import-v1.js companion into the existing protected_archive, then finalized only by pppp-tender-protected-archive-analysis. Tender Supplier Sourcing is an additive read-only Action Console module: canonical BOM first when uniquely resolved, strict Supplier Intelligence evidence, and on-demand external discovery only. No tender becomes a project, no supplier is selected, and no RFQ/email is sent without a human decision.
AI providers remain explicit and human-triggered.
